name: Grounded fact-checking
description: Is a claim supported by the document? The check you run on RAG answers before trusting them.
system: Decide whether the claim is fully supported by the document. Answer with exactly one word: supported or unsupported.

items.prompt:
Document: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 for the World's Fair in Paris.
Claim: The Eiffel Tower was finished in 1889.

Document: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 for the World's Fair in Paris.
Claim: The Eiffel Tower was built for the 1900 Olympics.

Document: Our premium plan costs $49 per month and includes 10 seats.
Claim: The premium plan includes 10 seats.

Document: Our premium plan costs $49 per month and includes 10 seats.
Claim: The premium plan includes unlimited seats.

Document: The patient was prescribed 20 mg of atorvastatin once daily.
Claim: The patient takes atorvastatin twice a day.

Document: Revenue rose from $2.1M in Q2 to $2.6M in Q3.
Claim: Revenue increased between Q2 and Q3.

Document: Revenue rose from $2.1M in Q2 to $2.6M in Q3.
Claim: Revenue more than doubled between Q2 and Q3.

Document: The library is open Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. It is closed on weekends.
Claim: The library is open on Saturdays.

Document: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun and has no moons.
Claim: Mercury has no natural satellites.

Document: The contract may be terminated by either party with 30 days' written notice.
Claim: Only the vendor can terminate the contract.

Document: The firmware update fixes the Bluetooth pairing bug and improves battery life by about 8%.
Claim: The update improves battery life.

Document: The firmware update fixes the Bluetooth pairing bug and improves battery life by about 8%.
Claim: The update adds Wi-Fi 7 support.

Document: Maria joined the company in 2019 as an analyst and became head of data in 2024.
Claim: Maria has led the data team since 2019.

Document: The bridge is 1.2 km long and carries four lanes of traffic.
Claim: The bridge is longer than one kilometre.

Document: Shipping is free for orders over $50 within the continental US.
Claim: All orders ship free worldwide.

Document: The study enrolled 412 adults aged 18 to 65 across three hospitals.
Claim: The study included participants from three hospitals.
